description:
News of a longtime crush—his close friend—getting married. Hyunwoo decides to finally put a period at the end of his long unrequited love. At the wedding, which he attends with a bitter heart, he meets his friend's younger brother, Heegeon. From that day on, Heegeon strangely starts hovering around Hyunwoo.

*"Can we keep in touch, hyung?"*

Hyunwoo, who is used to loving one person for a long time, and Heegeon, who slowly awakens new feelings inside him. A new connection that arrives after a love he thought was over. What name will the relationship between these two come to be called? *(Source: RIDI, translated)*
